## Assimilate Pro v2.1.0

Signed production Android release of **Assimilate Pro** — cultural & systems guide for newcomers to the West (2026 edition).

### Download
- **Assimilate-Pro-v2.1.0-release.apk** (signed, installable)

### Install
```bash
adb install -r Assimilate-Pro-v2.1.0-release.apk
```
Or copy the APK to your phone and open it (allow install from this source if prompted).

### What’s included
- Full offline guide (same content as the website)
- 2026 essentials: digital bureaucracy, housing, work rights, scams, health
- 9 regions + quizzes & scenarios
- Privacy-first: progress stored only on device
- R8 minify + resource shrink; APK Signature Scheme v2
